messages:
Neha (Product): Need a skinny launch plan for regulated pilot. Customer demands reservations + tamper-evident audit. What do we actually need to ship for pilot?
Liam (Eng-Arch): Routing templates + a quota-enforced slice. Basic policy DSL. Fallback variants.
Jordan (SRE): Per-tenant P95/P99 dashboards, canary rollback hook, and a short cutover runbook. Add failure-injection test.
Vivian (Solutions): Sales will accept signed audit manifests + reservation UI if KMS/VPC delayed. They need clear SLA wording.
Mike (Eng Lead): MLP: 1) routing templates + API, 2) slice create/quota, 3) audit -> S3 + signed manifest, 4) canary + fallback. Defer KMS/VPC.
Ava (Sales): Confirm pricing bands for reservations. We need dates to close.
Neha (Product): Draft acceptance checklist to include console+API for routing, slice lifecycle, per-tenant metrics, reservation flow, audit manifest, canary/runbook. Liam -> RFC (EOD), Jordan -> SRE checklist (tomorrow), Mike -> scope PR (Mon). rollout-bot: Epic 'pilot-slice' created for Q3-beta.
